# What should your escape room charge, and how full does it have to be?

> Free escape room pricing calculator: rooms, hours, game and reset length, price per player, occupancy and costs in; monthly profit, break-even occupancy, best price per player and build-cost payback out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/escape-room-pricing-capacity-planner/)
